hero.sub: MosaVali learns from your financial history, your goals and Georgia-specific risks — GEL depreciation, inflation, NBG rate changes — and shows you how to organize your savings.

problem.title:
Investing isn't gambling.
Investing without a plan is.
problem.body: Most people who lose money investing don't pick bad stocks. They run out of cash at the wrong moment.

forcedSale.title: Forced sale at a loss
forcedSale.body: Selling when prices are down turns a temporary dip into a real loss.

gambling.title: "Investing is gambling"

deposits.label: Georgian household savings stay in bank deposits.

foreign.label: of deposits are held in foreign currency.

problem.answer: MosaVali breaks the chain at step two: it sets aside a protected buffer first, so investments never have to be sold in a bad month.

sim.title: Crisis simulator
sim.lead: Before you choose, live through a real-world-shaped crisis with 10,000 virtual lari in your mission. It takes about a minute.

S08.title: 2008–09 · War and global crisis
S08.desc: Global shares almost halve and the lari is devalued.

S15.title: 2014–15 · Lari shock
S15.desc: The lari loses about a quarter of its value against the dollar.

S20.title: 2020 · Pandemic
S20.desc: Markets crash in March and the lari falls 14%, then both recover.

S22.title: 2022 · Inflation, stronger lari
S22.desc: Prices rise about 10%, shares fall and the lari strengthens.

ALL.title: All four crises
ALL.desc: The full tour, about 50 months with 7 decisions.

sim.how1: The crisis plays month by month. Your line is what your money buys of your goal; the dashed line is simply holding.
sim.how2: At the worst moments it pauses with the news of the day and asks what you would do.
sim.how3: You get a behaviour score and see which missions fit how you really react. The compliance agent uses it (rule BEH-01).
sim.howNote: Stylised monthly paths with today's instruments. Illustrative, not exact history.
sim.chartNote: Dashed line: simply holding. Faint lines: the other missions.
